title: ByteStash 1.5.0 before 1.6.1 contains a login cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the /api/auth/oidc/callback…
description: ByteStash versions from 1.5.0 up to but not including 1.6.1 have a login cross-site request forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in the /api/auth/oidc/callback endpoint. The vulnerability arises because the OpenID Connect (OIDC) state parameter is not bound to the initiating browser session. This flaw allows an attacker to initiate an OIDC login with their own account and trick a victim into opening the callback URL, causing the victim to be logged into the attacker's account and potentially exposing saved snippets.
